content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.created_at, o.id, o.status, o.created_at as order_created FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'captured' AND o.status != 'confirmed' AND p.created_at > :now - 300", "why": "Find captured payments where the order exists but is not confirmed, to understand if order confirmation is delayed"}], "hypotheses": [], "summary": "Investigating captured payments with unconfirmed orders to identify confirmation delays"}
